summary: Adefovir Dipivoxil carries the strongest United States boxed warning for liver damage, kidney harm, and changes to the body's chemistry [3][6]. The FDA warning also notes risks of severe flare-ups of hepatitis (liver inflammation), HIV resistance, lactic acidosis (acid buildup in the blood), and severe hepatomegaly with steatosis (enlarged liver with fat buildup) [6]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a high risk score for the liver and a low risk score for the heart [M]. Similar drugs also carry boxed warnings in the United States for liver harm and immune system problems [4][5].
